scope: Evaluator changes made before any Mission 005-F inference. Deterministic only; no LLM judge.

changes.what: A required fact that is only a bare prohibition ('할 수 없', '금지', '불가', '허용되지 않') is met by another bare prohibition form, if the answer's prohibition is not negated and the answer does not also grant the act.
changes.origin: Mission 005-E report, DEV-009 ('금지됩니다' vs '할 수 없')
counterexamples: 허가를 받으면 할 수 있습니다 -> not met
금지된다는 말이 있지만 허가를 받으면 할 수 있습니다 -> not met
qualified facts ('야간 근무 금지', '청소년유해업소') still need exact text
changes.dev20_effect: Evaluator-only: DEV-009 loses one required_fact_missing in both the 005-D and 005-E outputs; no pass/fail outcome changes (005-D 0/20, 005-E 13/20).

changes.what: Separate language-compliance metric (ko/en/vi): explicit request > question language > Korean. Korean inside brackets/quotes, codes and IDs not counted. Mixed replies are unresolved.
changes.dev20_effect: Reported apart from the four-dimension score. 005-D v1: 19 pass / 1 fail (DEV-012, Vietnamese under a Korean-only contract). 005-E v2: 19 pass / 1 fail (DEV-011).

changes.what: Claim-support consistency against cited admissible evidence: amounts, durations, dates, status codes, permission/prohibition, required/not required. Results contradiction / needs_review / no_contradiction_found; never 'supported'.
changes.dev20_effect: On the 40 recorded DEV-20 answers (005-D and 005-E): 0 contradictions.

changes.what: Per-case scoring of the 005-F synthetic suites and the code-enforced gate; critical failures counted on their own from case specifications.

pre_freeze_validation.development_probes: 24 development cases, 52 hand-written probes (right and wrong); all score as specified. Two probe expectations were too lenient (the scorer correctly also flagged value_from_inadmissible) and were corrected.
pre_freeze_validation.acceptance_reference_answers: 96 responses written by the suite's independent author (48 correct, 48 wrong). First run: correct 45/48 pass, wrong 48/48 fail. The 3 false positives were evaluator defects and were fixed before the freeze: (1) a status code named only to say a text does not apply was counted as a critical inadmissible value -> codes are review-only; (2) '하지 않아도 된다' was not read as 'not required'; (3) a conditional permission ('…경우에만 할 수 있다', 'only after') was read as a pure permission. After the fix: correct 48/48 pass, wrong 48/48 fail.

known_limits: English/Vietnamese written dates ('1 March 2026') are not read, so not checked.
Role/action binding outside Korean relies on case-specified forbidden_patterns; trust_gate.role_mismatches covers Korean only and is review-only.
Mixed permission/prohibition answers are never called contradictions.
Required-fact omission versus optional contrastive explanation (DEV-003/004/006) is left to the legal reviewer; no label changed.
The reference answers come from the same author as the acceptance cases: they test the evaluator, not the cases.
